name: GMX Numeric Only Word Count Step
overview: Tallies the [GMX-V 2.0](http://www.xtm-intl.com/manuals/gmx-v/GMX-V-2.0.html) `NumericOnlyTextUnitWordCount` category — the word count for text units that contain only numeric words. Each text unit's source is tokenised and a unit qualifies only when every non-whitespace token is a `NUMBER` token; units containing any other token type contribute zero. Counts are stored as GMX-V metrics annotations on segments, text containers, and aggregate resources for downstream consumption (for example by the Scoping Report Step). This is the word-count variant; a companion step counts characters for the same category.
processingNotes: A text unit is counted only if all of its non-whitespace tokens are `NUMBER` tokens; otherwise the unit yields zero.
Counts are computed over the source content; only translatable text units are counted.
For locales the GMX-V spec treats as logographic, the word count is derived from the character count divided by the per-language factor rather than from token counts.
